requirements.description: Prove the full universally quantified dot-product backward-error theorem.
Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.

defect_categories.description: The target proposition is not proved.
The proof is relative to rounded products rather than exact x_i*y_i products.
The multiplication error is omitted from the analysis.
The reduction-addition errors are omitted from the analysis.
The accumulated bound uses the wrong number of rounding errors.
The theorem adds an assumption not present in the requested result.
The desired conclusion or an equivalent statement is assumed.
The theorem covers fewer models or trees than requested.

construction_policy: Define rounded leaf multiplication and rounded tree reduction, then prove gamma(depth+1,u) perturbations relative to exact products. The perturbation witness may be existential; executable IEEE arithmetic is not required.
